lines: - Batch-8-Warnungen: `ticketSystem` (Permission-Overwrites, Kategorie-Suche, Transkript-Limit, DM-Fallback); `statsCommands` (Pool-Env, `$1`-Queries, Staff-Gate, Embed-Felder); `roleManager` (Reaction-Mapping, Hierarchie-Check, Bulk-Schleife)
